mechanism: Phenytoin induces CYP450 enzymes (CYP3A4, CYP2D6) leading to increased prochlorperazine metabolism and reduced efficacy; both drugs increase seizure threshold lowering risk.
action: Monitor for reduced antiemetic efficacy of prochlorperazine and potential breakthrough seizures; consider alternative antiemetic or increased prochlorperazine dosing with close clinical monitoring.
